name: Scribiva
description: Companion for the Scribiva voice-dictation client. Types dictated text into the focused text field through the GNOME input method (no clipboard, one undo step), after checking that the window is still the one that was focused when recording stopped. Exposes only the focused window's app id, WM class, window id and process id to the local client over the session D-Bus, never titles or content. Shows a top-bar recording indicator that never takes focus.
